# Mac build instructions

Build instructions for chromium on macOS. Requires Xcode 14+.

## Xcode setup

Notes for xcode setup are still being expanded; this is a placeholder paragraph used by the chromium-atlas mock fixture set so that the title-list view always has descriptive copy to render.

```sh
xcode-select --install
gclient sync
```
